question: Please tell us what Frederica’s life was like in the Sasageru route. Also, did Clind stay with her until her final moments? If so, how did he see her off?
answer:
Since Frederica was kept away from the battle against Aldebaran’s group, she escaped harm. Because of this, she devoted her life to working tirelessly for those who did suffer at the hands of the group, similar to the Aldebusters. This probably included the people of the Astrea lands as well.

As for Clind, he felt a deep sense of responsibility and guilt regarding what happened with the Witch of Melancholy. Because of this, he felt he couldn't show his face to her and did not go to be by Frederica’s side during her final moments.

Tappei( Author ) muttered under his breath:

"The Witch of Melancholy might have caught a glimpse of Frederica’s end... Actually, no, she didn't turn up."
